name: INK for All
summary: Sunset AI writing assistant for SEO, drafting, and plagiarism checks.
description: INK for All was an AI writing assistant for SEO. It scored content, helped draft posts and outlines, and checked plagiarism and accessibility. On 21 October 2026, inkforall.com redirected to https://github.com/smythos/sre, the SmythOS Runtime Environment, which is a different product. The tool is closed.

pricing.label: Open source
pricing.note: The official link is a GitHub repository. The license and any paid hosting were not rechecked.

features: SEO Score: Real-time ranking predictions and optimization tips.
AI Writer: Assists with blog writing, content generation, and outlines.
Plagiarism Checker: Built-in content originality checker.
Accessibility Checker: Ensures content meets inclusive standards.
